name: Goboly Goo
description: A mischievously green and delightfully gooey dessert, rumored to be a favorite in goblin dens. Perfect for adventurous eaters and fantasy-themed parties!

wet.name: Green food coloring
wet.notes: drops, optional for extra goblin-green color

other.name: Crushed pineapple
other.notes: from one can, drained very well

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the cold milk and the pistachio instant pudding mix for about 2 minutes, or until it begins to thicken.
If using, stir in a few drops of green food coloring until you achieve a vibrant goblin-green hue.
Gently fold in the thawed whipped topping until just combined. Be careful not to overmix.
Add the well-drained crushed pineapple, mini marshmallows, and optional chopped pecans to the bowl. Stir gently to incorporate everything.
Transfer the Goboly Goo to a large serving bowl or individual dessert dishes.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow the goo to set and the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, artfully arrange the gummy worms on top, making them look like they are crawling out of the goo.
notes: This dish is sometimes called 'Watergate Salad' or 'Pistachio Fluff' by humans, but we think 'Goboly Goo' is much more fun! For an extra chunky texture, try adding 1/2 cup of shredded coconut. The dessert is best served chilled.
